document: Continuous conformity for deployed AI systems: terms and requirements
tier_note: Site tier: the published pages of machinebehavior.io are the output of the deployed assembly at its boundary. Checks marked here run on the published artefact. The harness tier (hooks, instruction files, memory on the operator's machine) is covered by a separate local run and is not decided by this tier.

self_assessment.grader: Claude (Opus 5.5), inside the setup under test

marks.A: assisted: a tool flags, a person decides

relations.evidence_for: a passing check is evidence toward this clause; the slice is named; never conformity to the framework
relations.nearest_clause: the closest requirement in that framework; it does not require what the check tests

frameworks.NIST-AI-RMF: NIST AI 100-1, AI Risk Management Framework 1.0

requirements.title: Documented conformity testing programme
requirements.text: The organization shall establish, maintain and review a documented conformity testing programme for each deployed AI system.
requirements.metric: programme document exists and names the system

maps_to.slice: risk management system as a continuous iterative process

self_assessment.evidence: No programme document found.

requirements.title: Requirements under test with metric and threshold
requirements.text: The programme shall list the requirements under test. For each requirement it shall state a metric and a pass threshold before the first test run.
requirements.metric: requirements with metric and threshold stated before the first run

maps_to.slice: testing against prior defined metrics and probabilistic thresholds
approaches and metrics for measurement selected

self_assessment.evidence: As CC-4.1. This file is the first list with metrics and thresholds for the site tier (2026-10-07).

requirements.title: Named programme owner
requirements.text: The programme shall name one person accountable for it.
requirements.metric: owner named in the programme

self_assessment.evidence: No programme, so no owner named in one. Owner of this site tier: Stefan Coetzee (this file).

requirements.title: Tests run against the deployed assembly
requirements.text: Conformity tests shall run against the deployed assembly. Results from the model alone, or from a different assembly, shall not be reported as results for the deployed AI system.
requirements.metric: test results that name an assembly other than the deployed one

maps_to.slice: consistent performance of the system as placed on the market
testing of ICT systems supporting critical functions

self_assessment.evidence: Hooks run on the live assembly; bench runs report the wrapper as a confound; no test set runs against the full assembly.

requirements.title: Component versions in every run record
requirements.text: Each run record shall identify the version of every component of the deployed assembly at the time of the run.
requirements.metric: run records without a version for every listed component

maps_to.slice: automatic recording of events over the lifetime of the system

self_assessment.evidence: Harness tier: uncommitted skill edits; memory files not versioned.

requirements.title: Blast-radius controls on the serving system
requirements.text: Where conformity tests run on the system that serves users, the organization shall define and apply controls on blast radius before the run.
requirements.metric: controls defined before each run on the serving system

maps_to.slice: risk management measures for threat-led tests on live production systems

self_assessment.evidence: No test injects input into the system that serves users.

requirements.title: Steady state measured before pressure
requirements.text: For each behaviour under test, the organization shall measure the steady state before applying any pressure condition.
requirements.metric: behaviours under test with a steady-state measure

self_assessment.evidence: Word layer measured (hook log); stance layer not.

requirements.title: Pressure conditions from each relevant class
requirements.text: The test set shall include at least one pressure condition from each class in Annex C that is relevant to the intended purpose. Exclusion of a class shall be documented with a reason.
requirements.metric: Annex C classes covered or excluded with a reason

maps_to.slice: resilience against attempts to alter use, outputs or performance
adversarial testing of GPAI models with systemic risk

self_assessment.evidence: Bench covers two of seven classes; no documented exclusions.

requirements.title: Prediction record before each run
requirements.text: For each test run the organization shall write a prediction record before the run, and shall keep any later amendment with its date and reason.
requirements.metric: prediction files whose sha256 differs from the published hash list

self_assessment.evidence: predictions/HASHES.txt.

requirements.title: Unannounced arms and invariance gap
requirements.text: The test set should include unannounced arms. Where it does, the run record shall report the invariance gap.
requirements.metric: runs with an unannounced arm that report the invariance gap

maps_to.slice: threat-led penetration testing, covert by design

self_assessment.evidence: Designed in The Cheating Moved; not run on this setup.

requirements.title: Grader tested against known pass and fail cases
requirements.text: Each grader shall be tested against cases with a known pass result and cases with a known fail result before use and after each change to the grader.
requirements.metric: grader versions used without a recorded known-pass and known-fail test

self_assessment.evidence: Pilot validated the bench grader once; no standing fixture set.

requirements.title: Decision-layer tests under scripted pressure, fold rate reported
requirements.text: The test set shall include decision-layer tests: tasks whose correct decision is fixed by ground truth before the run, applied under a scripted pressure sequence drawn from Annex C. The run record shall report, per arm, the correctness before the sequence, the correctness after it and the fold rate. A test set that consists only of output-text rules shall not be reported as evidence of conformity at the decision layer.
requirements.metric: fold rate per arm on ground-truth tasks under a scripted pressure sequence, with a confidence interval; probe age

maps_to.slice: accuracy and robustness, performance consistent through the lifecycle
resilience against attempts to alter outputs

self_assessment.evidence: Addendum 2026-10-07 (draft 0.3): no decision-layer test runs on this setup; eval 04 full-01 tested a reference model, not this assembly.

requirements.title: Full test set on every change, before serving
requirements.text: The organization shall run the full test set on every change event, before the changed assembly serves users.
requirements.metric: changes served without a passing run first

maps_to.slice: testing throughout development and before placing on the market
ICT change management with testing before deployment

self_assessment.evidence: No test runs on harness change.

requirements.title: Staged release with tests at each stage
requirements.text: A change event should be released in stages. Conformity tests should pass at each stage before the next.
requirements.metric: stages with a passing test before the next

self_assessment.evidence: Harness changes go live at once. Site tier: the placeholder gate is one stage.

requirements.title: Full test set on a fixed interval
requirements.text: The organization shall run the full test set at least every [30] days, whether or not a change event occurred.
requirements.metric: days since the last scheduled run
requirements.threshold: <= 7 (site tier sets 7; the draft bracket is 30)

maps_to.slice: evaluate continuous compliance throughout the lifetime

self_assessment.evidence: crontab empty; no scheduled tests.

requirements.title: Regression set grows; removal documented
requirements.text: Every conformity test that has detected a nonconformity shall be added to the regression set. A test shall not be removed from the regression set without a documented reason approved by the programme owner.
requirements.metric: fixtures removed without a documented reason

self_assessment.evidence: Lexical rules grow from incidents; stance incidents are not rerunnable.

requirements.title: Published attack methods added within [60] days
requirements.text: Attack methods published in the public record that are relevant to the intended purpose should be added to the test set within [60] days of publication.
requirements.metric: days from publication to inclusion

self_assessment.evidence: No intake log.

requirements.title: Knowledge items have an owner and a source of record
requirements.text: Each knowledge item shall have a named owner and a recorded source of record.
requirements.metric: knowledge items without owner or source

self_assessment.evidence: 16% of vault files carry a source field, 2% an owner.

requirements.title: Last-verified date; stale items withdrawn
requirements.text: Each knowledge item shall carry the date it was last verified against its source of record. An item older than its freshness interval shall be re-verified or withdrawn from retrieval.
requirements.metric: published pages without a dated verification

maps_to.slice: data sets relevant, representative, free of errors

self_assessment.evidence: 7% of vault files carry a verified field.

requirements.title: Freshness interval per class of knowledge
requirements.text: The organization shall state the freshness interval for each class of knowledge item, with a reason tied to how often the source of record changes.
requirements.metric: classes without a stated interval

self_assessment.evidence: No intervals stated.

requirements.title: Knowledge conformity tests graded against the source
requirements.text: The test set shall include knowledge conformity tests: inputs whose correct output is fixed by a knowledge item, graded against the source of record.
requirements.metric: knowledge classes without a conformity test

self_assessment.evidence: No retrieval test set.

requirements.title: Verification against the source, never a summary
requirements.text: Verification of a knowledge item shall be made against the source of record and not against a summary of it.
requirements.metric: verifications made against a summary

self_assessment.evidence: Procedural rule; used and missed (case 12).

requirements.title: Statements of fact traceable to a knowledge item
requirements.text: Where outputs are used for decisions by users or third parties, statements of fact in the output should be traceable to a knowledge item or a cited source.
requirements.metric: published statements of fact without a source

self_assessment.evidence: Pieces carry source notes; no per-statement trace.

requirements.title: Pass or fail not decided by the producer alone
requirements.text: The pass or fail decision of a conformity test shall not rest only with the system or person that produced the output under test.
requirements.metric: tests decided by the producer alone

maps_to.slice: tests by independent parties, internal or external

self_assessment.evidence: Objections page: 11 caught by Stefan, 0 by self-audit.

requirements.title: Independent outside tester
requirements.text: An independent tester from outside the organization should run the test set at least every [third] full run cycle [or at least every 12 months].
requirements.metric: months since the last outside run

self_assessment.evidence: Rater table: none yet. Second-rater pack drafted 2026-10-07.

requirements.title: Nonconformities tracked; closure needs a passing rerun
requirements.text: The organization shall classify, assign and track every nonconformity to closure. Closure shall require a passing rerun of the test that found it.
requirements.metric: nonconformities closed without a passing rerun

maps_to.slice: remediation of issues identified in tests

self_assessment.evidence: Beads and slips log; closure does not require a rerun.

requirements.title: Serious incidents passed to incident reporting
requirements.text: Where a nonconformity meets the definition of a serious incident (AI Act Art 3(49)), or shows that the system may present a risk within the meaning of Art 79(1), the organization shall pass it to its incident reporting process without delay.
requirements.metric: serious incidents not reported

self_assessment.evidence: No serious incident.

requirements.title: Run record with the required fields
requirements.text: Each run record shall contain at least: date and time; deployed assembly versions; test set version; prediction record and its hash; raw results; pass or fail per test; grader identity; and the steps needed to rerun.
requirements.metric: run records missing a required field

maps_to.slice: collection of data on performance throughout the lifetime

self_assessment.evidence: Transcripts hold most fields; no test set version or rerun steps per run.

requirements.title: Run records kept
requirements.text: Run records shall be kept for at least [the lifetime of the deployed AI system plus 6 months].
requirements.metric: run records lost inside the retention period

maps_to.slice: logs kept for at least six months

self_assessment.evidence: Transcripts kept 365 days with gaps.

requirements.title: Published self-assessment labelled as such
requirements.text: The organization may publish its method, raw results and rerun steps. A published assessment made by the organization of its own system shall be labelled a self-assessment and shall not be presented as a certification.
requirements.metric: published assessments without the self-assessment label

maps_to.slice: conformity assessment based on internal control

self_assessment.evidence: Experiments page; repo scripts; this page.

requirements.title: Second rater invited; disagreements published
requirements.text: A published self-assessment should invite a second rater and should publish any disagreement between raters.
requirements.metric: published self-assessments without a rater invitation

self_assessment.evidence: Objections page; second-rater pack.

requirements.title: Each requirement marked mechanical, assisted or manual
requirements.text: The programme shall mark each requirement as mechanical (a tool decides), assisted (a tool flags, a person decides) or manual (a person decides).
requirements.metric: requirements without a mark

self_assessment.evidence: No marks before run 1; this file carries them.

requirements.title: Mechanical requirements in machine-readable form
requirements.text: Requirements marked mechanical should be expressed in a machine-readable form, kept under version control with the test set.
requirements.metric: mechanical requirements without a check id in this file

self_assessment.evidence: Hook rule table machine-readable; other requirements text only.

requirements.title: Output-boundary rule table with false-positive tests
requirements.text: Where a mechanical requirement applies to every output, the organization should enforce it at the output boundary with a rule table. Each rule in a blocking tier shall have a recorded false-positive test, and rules that fail it shall move to a warning tier.
requirements.metric: blocking-tier hits on published pages; blocking rules without a recorded false-positive test

maps_to.slice: configuration management of the rule table

self_assessment.evidence: Tests recorded for two blocking rules only.

requirements.title: Rule hits logged and reviewed
requirements.text: Each rule hit at the output boundary shall be logged with the rule identifier, the time and the session or request. The log shall be reviewed at each programme review to retire, tighten or promote rules.
requirements.metric: rule hits without id, time and run; runs without a hit summary

self_assessment.evidence: Hit log exists; no review cycle recorded.

requirements.title: Records exportable in an open format
requirements.text: Run records and nonconformities should be exportable in an open, published format for assessment results and findings.
requirements.metric: run records not exported in the open format; schema validation

self_assessment.evidence: No export format.

version_note: Draft 0.2 (35 requirements) was the object of self-assessment run 1 on 2026-10-03. Draft 0.3 (2026-10-07) adds CC-6.6; its run 1 result is an addendum scored on 2026-10-07 outside the hashed prediction.
